notes.title: Patch Notes | 02.09.2025
notes.notes: [p]Deadhunters! A new update has rolled out for Zombie Army VR! As always a massive thank you to the slayers who have submitted bug reports and suggestions. Please check out a full list of notes below.[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][p][/p][h3]General[/h3][p]· Stability, performance and AI improvements[/p][p]· Art improvements including correction of floating weapons, and updates to textures for a selection of rifles[/p][p]· Small adjustments to Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese localisation where characters did not appear correctly[/p][p]· Haptic feedback now consistently performs across supported ProTube devices including the ProTube pistol[/p][p]· Added further haptic support for PSVR2[/p][p]· The Fowl Play achievement now consistently unlocks for both players in co-op after fulfilling the requirements[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where players could experience a softlock after removing their headset for a certain amount of time[/p][p]· Updated the PCVR rank list to reflect played hours, minutes and seconds rather than the previous incorrect numbering[/p][p]· Sniper zombies will now consistently focus on bait when bait mines are detonated[/p][p]· The path of bait and divine grenades thrown via triggers has been improved[/p][p]· The correct tooltip now appears for the zoom tooltip after switching the primary hand to the left[/p][p]· In co-op, zombies will now consistently target the alive player when the other player is in the downed state[/p][p]· The checkpoint progress warning for co-op will only trigger when players select ‘Quit to Hub’[/p][p]· Helmets removed from zombies will no longer jump off the floor when they are decapitated[/p][p]· Resolved an issue where players were unable to interact with medkits and syringes if they took a medkit out and then closed the Medbox door[/p][p]· When using Quest headsets in Link Mode via Oculus desktop app, the title audio will now automatically come out of the headset speakers until the player changes this via Windows audio settings[/p][p][/p][h2]The Tomented Garrison (Chapter 1, Level 2)[/h2][p]· The Claw hammer now blinks red to indicate damage to the weapon when hitting zombies[/p][p]· Removed an invisible wall near the door present in the Bunker area[/p][p]Camp Fear (Chapter 1, Level 3)[/p][p]· Resolved an issue where, under certain conditions, the initial zombies in the Farmstead South area could get stuck behind the gate[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where the previous waypoint marker to leave the safe room could fail to disappear after reloading the first checkpoint[/p][p]· Resolved an issue where, under certain circumstances, the waypoint marker on the lever for the final boss fight could fail to appear[/p][p][/p][h2]The Pit of Despair (Chapter 2, Level 2)[/h2][p]· Resolved an issue where players could partially fall through the stairs outside the Portal room located at the end of the level[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where players using teleport movement could get stuck after teleporting outside the airlock area[/p][p][/p][h2]The Lurking Fear (Chapter 3, Level 1)[/h2][p]· The Grab indicator now consistently highlights when players attempt to pick up ammo from the ammo crate in the corridor following the Upstairs Lab[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where zombies could be observed immediately falling to the ground after spawning in on a platform in the Reactor Silo[/p][p][/p][h2]Alarums (Chapter 3, Level 2)[/h2][p]· Resolved an issue where the chapter’s loading screen narration voice lines could overlap with the voice lines that play once players have loaded into the level[/p][p][/p][h2]From the Pinnacle to the Pit (Chapter 4, Level 1)[/h2][p]· The Grenadier will now melee attack players without fail throughout the gameplay[/p][p][/p][h2]The Harbinger of Doom (Chapter 4, Level 2)[/h2][p]· Removed an invisible wall attached to one of the ruined walls in by the floodlight in the first forest area[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes | 30.07.2025
notes.notes: [p]Deadhunters, a new update has parachuted in for those of you on the frontlines.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for all of your reports and feedback. We really appreciate it. notes.title: Patch Notes | 01.07.2025
notes.notes: [h2]General[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved general stability and performance including tackling some areas where FPS drops could occur[/p][/*][*][p]Made improvements to online play including to connectivity and voice chat[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a variety of environmental art adjustments and corrections[/p][/*][*][p]Improved zombie behaviour throughout the game including animation and pathing corrections[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Snap Turn functionality to offer a smoother experience[/p][/*][*][p]Zombies will now more effectively target the player shooting at them when they are focussed on another player[/p][/*][*][p]Zombies will now respond to bait grenades whenever players denotate them[/p][/*][*][p]Grenadiers will now take damage from grenades in all circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Players are now able to open the Pause menu in all intended circumstances; including during killcam[/p][/*][*][p]Improved 3D audio for weapon fire for all weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Suicider zombies will now explode in all intended circumstances after getting eliminated by players[/p][/*][*][p]Indicator for weapons being out of ammo now appears consistently in all situations where it should[/p][/*][*][p]Damage from physical/melee attacks now always applies correctly to Grenadier zombies[/p][/*][*][p]Players’ multiplayer voice chat volume settings will no longer revert to default after closing and relaunching the app[/p][/*][*][p]The names of challenges now appear correctly in all menus[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the M1 Garand’s ejected ammo would fail to get restocked back to the ammo pouch while reloading the weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Ammo crates will now close automatically while using teleport mode during gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Grenadiers will no longer stop throwing grenades when a player’s height is low or crouched[/p][/*][*][p]Heads of welding helmet zombies will now correctly dismember after headshots[/p][/*][*][p]Melee hits with a gun on zombies will now play the correct sound in all circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the circular attachment was detaching from the butt of the rifle upon pulling the bolt back for the M1903 Springfield[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where ammo crates would fail to open for co-op players if one of the players quit the level[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a blood bubble reappears on reloading the checkpoint after completing blood fountains[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where Bridgette’s body would not appear[/p][/*][*][p]Divine grenade effect will now disappear from zombies as intended[/p][/*][*][p]After taking off their headset for a few minutes during a co-op session, players can now use the Pause menu to quit to the Hub as is intended to be possible[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where sometimes the loading screen banner could look inverted after reloading a checkpoint in co-op[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sometimes suicider zombies would disappear after a red barrel exploded near them[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where syringes dropped by Medic Grunts would fail to disappear upon reloading the previous checkpoint[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a "Connection error" pop-up could unnecessarily appear when scrolling down the leaderboard positions[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where Loading Screens could be incorrectly positioned, under certain conditions, for players in co-op[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the 'Waiting for all players to be Ready' text would incorrectly switch to English for players playing in a non-English language[/p][/*][*][p]When used with the M1903 Springfield, the Damage Upgrade attachment will now, as intended, increase the damage output of the rifle[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved circumstances where players were unable to switch from Teleport to Free movement in the Options menu[/p][/*][*][p]The Reserve Ammo attachment is now positioned correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Throwing guns at zombies will now stagger them as intended[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Shooting Range[/h2][list][*][p]An invisible wall has been removed from the righthand side of the workbench[/p][/*][*][p]The Countdown timer board now prompts players to choose a gun, as intended, after dropping a weapon outside the training area[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Back To Basics (Chapter 1, Level 1)[/h2][list][*][p]Hermann’s dialogue now stops as intended when pausing the game, and continues as normal after unpausing[/p][/*][*][p]Hermann's speaking animation now works as intended during a player’s second interaction with him[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]The Tormented Garrison (Chapter 1, Level 2)[/h2][list][*][p]Resolved an issue where some players on the Quest 3 experienced a title hang after fighting the horde in the bunker[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, in certain circumstances, the document in the Comms Bunker would not spawn in[/p][/*][*][p]The gate leading to the Comms Bunker will now open correctly for both players in co-op regardless of chosen movement style[/p][/*][*][p]The Safe Room is now highlighted as intended with a green lightbulb in the final trench area[/p][/*][*][p]The invisible wall that players could hit on their way out of the Safe Area has been removed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Camp Fear (Chapter 1, Level 3)[/h2][list][*][p]Players in co-op will no longer get stuck before the door if they backtrack when their co-op partner is entering the Bunker[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where one of the masked zombies could be seen standing still after spawning in the first wave of zombies in the Zombie Commander arena[/p][/*][*][p]The Zombie Commander at the end of the level can now be heard, as intended, for the duration of the fight[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Excavation Extermination (Chapter 2, Level 1)[/h2][list][*][p]Zombies will now die as intended when they jump off the metal walkway during blocked[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]The Pit of Despair (Chapter 2, Level 2)[/h2][list][*][p]The final objective marker now disappears for both players on the mission complete screen during shut behind players in all situations as intended[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]The Lurking Fear (Chapter 3, Level 1)[/h2][list][*][p]The Cleaver that players can find in a certain location now breaks as intended after repeated use[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved some conditions where a zombie could get stuck out of bounds[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Alarums (Chapter 3, Level 2)[/h2][list][*][p]Resolved an issue where restarting the first checkpoint could briefly empty the ammo crate[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]From the Pinnacle to the Pit (Chapter 4, Level 1)[/h2][list][*][p]The Grenadier zombie now only appears once, as intended, during his introduction in the first Ruined Pathway area[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where co-op players in teleport mode could become stuck if they were in the hut when the Blood Sigil gate triggered[/p][/*][*][p]Subtitles now play out correctly for the dialogues triggered upon reaching the checkpoint in the Graveyard area, and during the Grenadier zombie encounter[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]The Harbinger of Doom (Chapter 4, Level 2)[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could get stuck behind the fog wall to the Crypt area in certain circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Throwing the femur to kill zombies will now contribute towards the level’s Z-Challenge[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]The Crucible of Horror (Chapter 5, Level
